what: An AI support agent for a Shopify store that asks before it acts.

guarantees.title: Nothing changes until you say yes
guarantees.text: A change is shown exactly as it will run, and it runs once, only after a clear yes.
guarantees.plain: Nothing happens until the customer says yes.

guarantees.title: Store policy is enforced in code
guarantees.text: Change windows, final sale, item condition, quantities, and addresses are checked before a change is shown.
guarantees.plain: The assistant checks the store's rules first.

guarantees.title: Facts come from the store
guarantees.text: Amounts, dates, order numbers, and tracking numbers in a reply are checked against store data or the cited policy.
guarantees.plain: The receipt comes from the store's records, not from the assistant's own words.
